build_bayesian_detector: build a Bayesian detector for SynthID text watermark detection from tokenized watermarked and unwatermarked outputs
train_bayesian_detector: train a Bayesian watermark detector using g-values, masks, and labels with cross-validation and L2 regularization
score_text_watermark: score text outputs for watermark probability using a trained BayesianDetector instance
process_raw_model_outputs: process raw tokenized model outputs into g-values, masks, and labels for detector training
compute_watermark_posterior: compute the posterior probability P(watermarked|g_values) using the BayesianDetectorModule
